description: Florian Kaufmann and colleagues publish experimental measurements from a reversible Organic Rankine Cycle and high-temperature heat-pump rig with a twin-screw machine at the Technical University of Munich. The grouped deposits contain first-characterisation raw data in heat-pump mode, first-characterisation raw data in ORC mode, and a subsequent oil-flow variation campaign in heat-pump mode. Each native description identifies the same laboratory equipment family; different operating modes and campaign roles are preserved. Zenodo provides CSV files freely under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is one laboratory test-rig programme. The metadata does not establish independence of all underlying observations, complete test dates, variable units or sampling intervals. Related conference publications analyse equipment performance and oil-system limitations. These measurements support validation and assessment of reversible geothermal energy equipment. No values were read, no experiment was reproduced and no campaign is counted as a separate resource.
